contact.address: 7101-A Woodrow Ave (Crestview) & 1804 Briarcliff Blvd (Windsor Park), Austin, TX

colour_palette.details: Dark forest green (#0f4b29, #1c5733) and charcoal (#1d1d23) with white. Feels like an uncustomized WordPress Astra theme starter palette rather than an artisan East Coast deli.

logo.details: Circular badge seal is loaded as a raster JPEG ('LittleDeli-Seal-Color.jpg', 500x257px), appearing soft on high-resolution Retina displays.

typography.details: Uses Roboto Condensed (400, 700) across body and headings. Clean and legible, but lacks rustic Italian-American warmth.

contact.details: Both location phone numbers, full addresses, hours of operation, and direct email are clearly accessible.

online_presence.details: WordPress + Astra theme + Elementor page builder. Yoast SEO is active, but heavy inline CSS and nested Elementor wrapper divs slow down mobile Largest Contentful Paint.

verdict.commercial_rationale: Beloved neighborhood institution for nearly two decades across two Austin locations. Upgrading to a fast, modern digital menu with streamlined mobile ordering would generate significant revenue lift.

sample_website.notes: Classic NYC-style deli & wood-fired pizza digital ordering showcase.
